column2: Article  5  -  Contents  of  Air  Waybill  or  Cargo  Receipt

column1: The  air  waybill  or  the  cargo  receipt  shall  include:

column2: an  indication  of  the  places  of  departure  and  destination;
if  the  places  of  departure  and  destination  are  within  the
territory  of  a  single  State  Party,  one  or  more  agreed  stopping
places  being  within  the  territory  of  another  State,  an
indication  of  at  least  one  such  stopping  place;  and
an  indication  of  the  weight  of  the  consignment.
